# ”Då lär AI om något stå i fokus”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-22  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon covers a risk-on session led by a rebound in AI stocks. Nasdaq rose 2.3%, Meta jumped 11% on its Muse AI assistant, and Nvidia, Alibaba, Intel and AMD all had AI news. Swedish banks hit all-time highs, but the hosts warn that valuations of 13-14x earnings, against a historical 9-10x, look stretched. Other items: Novo Nordisk fell after its capital markets day as GLP-1 competition grows, Swedish e-commerce sales dropped 9%, Sampo plans to sell more Noba shares, Green Landscaping issued a profit warning with a savings programme, and Skanska and NCC announced order and partnership news.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 SWED-A — Swedbank | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

New ATH above 400 SEK, but host sees stretched valuation at 13-14x vs historical 9-10x. Suggests collecting the dividend rather than expecting more upside.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion: banks re-rated to 13-14x earnings against a historical 9-10x, so upside looks limited ('snart måste det vara slut'). Possible Riksbank, ECB and Fed hikes support earnings, but valuation limits further gains. This implies holding for the dividend rather than adding.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rate hike expectations reverse
- if valuation expands further without earnings growth

> *"Det är väl uppåt 13–14 gånger nu. De har historiskt handlats runt 9–10, så det börjar se lite ansträngt ut. Snart måste det vara slut."*

---

### 🟡 SEB-A — SEB | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

At an ATH with the sector. Host view is that bank valuations look stretched.

#### Reasoning

Same sector-wide host view as for Swedbank: valuation above historical levels, so the stance is dividend and hold rather than buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rate outlook turns lower
- if valuation stretches further

> *"SEB och Nordea också på all-time-high."*

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

At an ATH with the sector. Host view is that bank valuations look stretched.

#### Reasoning

Same sector-wide host view as for Swedbank: valuation above historical levels, so the stance is dividend and hold rather than buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rate outlook turns lower
- if valuation stretches further

> *"SEB och Nordea också på all-time-high."*

---

### 🟠 NOBA — Noba | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Sampo plans to sell 14-15m shares worth about 1.3bn SEK, creating near-term supply pressure.

#### Reasoning

Host flags Noba as important to watch today because Sampo's second block sale (after 10m shares earlier this year) creates an overhang and likely a pricing discount in the short term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if placement priced at deep discount
- if Sampo signals further sales

> *"Viktigt att hålla koll på Noba, hur den går på börsen i dag."*

---

### 🟠 GREEN — Green Landscaping | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Press release: one-off costs in Q3 and an improvement programme due to a negative profit trend in Norway and Sweden.

#### Reasoning

The negative earnings trend led to restructuring costs. The host says to watch the open, and a negative near-term reaction is likely. The improvement programme could help in the longer term, but that is not yet proven.

#### Sell Triggers

- if profit trend keeps deteriorating
- if improvement programme fails to lift margins

> *"Green Landscaping också är värt att hålla koll på hur den går i öppning."*

---

### 🟠 BOOZT — Boozt | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Swedish e-commerce fell 9% in August. Unclear whether tariffs on Temu and Shein are net positive for European players.

#### Reasoning

The hosts speculate that weak e-commerce statistics could weigh on Boozt, though tariffs on Chinese low-cost rivals might be net positive. There is no clear direction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Nordic e-commerce keeps declining

> *"Vi får se om Boozt kan få sig en släng av den här statistiken."*

---

### 🟠 DOM — Dometic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Customer Thor Industries reports its fiscal Q4 today, which may affect Dometic.

#### Reasoning

Thor Industries' results show RV demand, and Dometic is a supplier to Thor. The host says to watch for read-across, but the report comes around lunch, so any effect may come late in the day.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Thor reports weak RV demand

> *"Det här är ju en Dometic kund så att jag tänker att det är viktigt att se hur det går i bolagets Q4"*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fell about 8% after its capital markets day on unimpressive targets. Eli Lilly and Roche presented strong competing data.

#### Reasoning

The market was disappointed by the capital markets day targets, and competition in obesity drugs is intensifying ('konkurrensen tilltar'). The tone is negative, but there is no explicit recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if competitors gain further share
- if targets are cut again

> *"Marknaden var inte så imponerad av målen."*
